verses.text:
Praise the LORD, all you nations!

Extol Him, all you peoples!

For great is His loving devotion toward us,

and the faithfulness of the LORD endures forever.


Hallelujah!

text: Praise the LORD, all you nations! Extol Him, all you peoples! For great is His loving devotion toward us, and the faithfulness of the LORD endures forever. Hallelujah!
